title: UC6 loan 1 period-1 schedule interest (Tier-D MNT replay)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the period-1 interest of UC6 loan 1 from the Tier-D MNT replay of LoanUpdateApprovedAmount.feature. This is the same candidate the pilot (F-2026-09-11-tierd-pilot-loan-refusal.md) transcribed in EUR and offered to the loan-schedule-interest seam, where it was refused by the tenant_params equality rule because the replay tenant was EUR and PIN-loan.json is MNT. The 2026-09-11 driver decision re-seeded the disposable oracle to MNT (same two minor digits, ISO 4217 496 vs 978, so the arithmetic is identical) and replayed the same scenario; this vector is re-transcribed from the MNT capture. request.schedule transcribes the observed principal 1000.000000 -> "100000" minor units, annualInterestRate 7.000000 -> 7, and the loan's observed day conventions daysInYearType.id 360 and daysInMonthType.id 30. expect.interest_minor transcribes periods[1].interestOriginalDue 5.830000 -> "583" minor units. Nothing was computed by this promotion. The observed 583 is NOT a HALF_UP/HALF_EVEN tie (100000*7*30/(100*360) = 583.33), so this vector corroborates the interest cell but does not discriminate the rounding mode; loan 1's schedule observes daysInPeriod 31, while the 360/30 conventions the request carries are the terms' declared interest basis (daysInYearType.days360 / daysInMonthType.days360).

provenance.note: request.schedule and expect.interest_minor are transcribed from the committed MNT capture loan-1-detail-associations-all-1.json, the UC6 loan 1 read-back while status was loanStatusType.submitted.and.pending.approval, carrying currency.code MNT (decimalPlaces 2). capture_case_id names the loan's externalId fe61fc1a-87f2-4180-ad97-6116ed335c36, which appears in the capture's top-level externalId. TENANT `tierd` -- NOT tenant `gerege`. IMAGE sha256:e596339626bf...; scenario LoanUpdateApprovedAmount.feature UC6; Asia/Ulaanbaatar; rounding mode 4 (HALF_UP); instance destroyed.
